name: Fabasoft AG
summary: Fabasoft AG, together with its subsidiaries, provides software products and cloud services for digital document, process, and file management in Austria, Germany, Switzerland, and internationally. The company offers Fabasphere, a cloud-based hub for documents and processes; and Fabasoft Cloud that provides content management and business processes.
